Definition: Eliezer, the name of a Damascene and of ten Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Eliezer is the name of a Damascene and of ten Israelites. In Genesis 15:2, the text says "and the steward of my house [is] this Eliezer of Damascus?" The life behind the name is told on the Eliezer of Damascus People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Eliezer matters because God knows His people by name, and Eliezer is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
RelatedEvents: The Call of Abraham; Jethro's Advice
